children: on Tuesday named finance chief Richard McPhail as its CEO, effective November 23.
McPhail will succeed Ted Decker, who took a medical leave of absence in August. The home improvement retailer said Decker has returned and will serve as chair of the board upon stepping down.

The executive shuffle at Home Depot also includes executives Jordan Broggi and Marie Campbell being promoted to the roles of chief financial officer and chief operating officer, respectively, as McPhail takes charge.
